name: EU DORA
description: EU Digital Operational Resilience Act controls covering ICT risk, incident reporting, resilience testing, and ICT third-party oversight. Short original summaries.

requirements.title: ICT risk management framework
requirements.summary: Governance, asset classification, protection, and continuity for critical ICT services.

children.title: ICT risk governance and policy
children.summary: Management maintains an approved ICT risk framework tied to business services.

children.title: Identification of critical ICT assets
children.summary: Critical business functions, dependencies, and data stores are mapped with owners.

children.title: Protection, encryption, and access control
children.summary: Strong authentication, network hardening, and cryptographic keys protect ICT systems.

children.title: ICT business continuity and backup
children.summary: Tested continuity plans and immutable backups meet defined recovery objectives.

requirements.title: ICT incident management and reporting
requirements.summary: Structured detection, classification, root-cause tracking, and regulator timelines.

children.title: Incident detection and timeline logging
children.summary: ICT incidents are classified by severity, tracked with timelines, and resolved within SLA.

children.title: Post-incident review and lessons
children.summary: Major incidents record root cause and corrective control improvements.

requirements.title: Digital operational resilience testing
requirements.summary: Recurring vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and recovery exercises.

children.title: Continuous vulnerability and pentest program
children.summary: Critical ICT systems undergo continuous scanning and independent penetration tests.

children.title: Failover and recovery testing
children.summary: Periodic recovery exercises validate failover plans and capture evidence.

requirements.title: ICT third-party risk management
requirements.summary: Register of ICT providers, criticality scoring, and exit readiness.

children.title: Third-party ICT register and reviews
children.summary: All ICT suppliers are inventoried, risk-scored, and reviewed annually.

children.title: Contractual security and audit rights
children.summary: Supplier agreements document data protection, SLA, and termination transitions.
